description: Preflight schema for the expanded, non-normative, release-blocked B01 selector-closure authoring snapshot. canonical_source_metadata preserves the decoded compact payload metadata for an exact recovery round trip. adr_allocation_inventory_binding binds the exact external inventory and schema bytes that the generator injects into the self-contained canonical payload. The semantic checker applies the complete closed-model validation after generation.

adr_allocation_inventory_binding.description: Exact byte and schema provenance for the bounded external allocation inventory. The generator resolves only the two named sibling files and injects the validated oracle into the canonical compact payload.

canonical_source_metadata.description: Canonical payload metadata preserved without loss during compact-to-authoring recovery.

closure_commitments.description: Maintained commitments for the generated canonical payload. The generator rejects a mismatch and never silently repairs these values.

resource_closure.description: Domain-separated commitment to the exact resource DEFINE, EFFECT, derived MUTATION, profile-binding, and joint-write-participant rows. This is derived local consistency evidence only.
